name: mcode-stack
description: Workflows and skills the MiniMax Code team uses to build MiniMax Code. Each stack installs as one plugin.

plugins.name: ronny
plugins.description: Daily workflows and self-check skills from the MiniMax Code R&D lead: independent review, subagent split checks, tool and context budget audits, long sessions, long commands, harness experiments, trajectory review, agent briefs, evidence-first review of agent output, review capacity and turning repeat corrections into checks, plus everyday engineering practice for code review, review comments, small PRs, change descriptions and emergency changes.

plugins.name: jiachen
plugins.description: Find the loops where you keep acting as a manual step for your agents (retrying, judging, approving, carrying context) and lift yourself out of them, plus a content pipeline that rewrites AI-sounding Chinese drafts and turns material into Xiaohongshu image posts and short vertical videos.

plugins.name: req-tpm
plugins.description: Requirement management where the requester and their agent act as the requirement's TPM: intake with a measurable expected outcome, priority recommendation for the owner, design decision record, cadence tracking that flags stale items, ship readiness, and evidence-based outcome review. Body in a Feishu doc, status in Meegle.

plugins.name: youfang
plugins.description: Turn architecture and flow diagrams into Keynote-style Magic Move slide decks: one offline HTML file where the boxes and titles two slides share morph and fly, in one of four visual styles (hand-drawn, minimal, dark neon, neo-brutalist) picked from rendered samples, with optional 4K video export.
